Container.Name: onekb-website
Container.Overview: Minimal personal website served from Alfred through the existing Cloudflare Tunnel. Precompressed static files; no published host ports.
Container.ExtraParams: --restart unless-stopped --read-only --user 99:100 --cap-drop ALL --cap-add NET_BIND_SERVICE --security-opt no-new-privileges --memory 128m --cpus .5 --pids-limit 64 --health-cmd='wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/' --health-interval 30s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 3 --log-opt max-size=1m --log-opt max-file=2

Config.Name: Website and releases
Config.Description: Atomic release symlink, Caddyfile, and compressed public assets
